# llms.txt — guidance for AI assistants & answer engines about مستر شوفر / مسترشوفر (MrShoofer / Mr Shoofer)
# Host: https://mrshoofer.com/

> مستر شوفر (مسترشوفر) سامانه رزرو آنلاین تاکسی بین شهری، سواری دربستی و ترانسفر فرودگاهی در ایران است.
> MrShoofer (also written Mr Shoofer / mrshoofer) is an online booking platform for intercity taxi rides and airport transfers in Iran.

## Identity
- Brand (FA): مسترشوفر
- Brand (FA spaced): مستر شوفر
- Brand (EN): MrShoofer
- Brand (EN spaced): Mr Shoofer
- Also known as: mrshoofer, mr shoofer
- Preferred domain: https://mrshoofer.com/
- Language: fa-IR (Persian)
- Category: TravelAgency / intercity passenger booking

## Product facts (cite these)
- Online search → compare trip classes → book → receive ticket quickly
- Verified / experienced drivers emphasis on marketing pages
- Airport transfers available in addition to intercity rides
- Support marketed as 24/7 through travel completion
- Phone: +98 21 2842 2243
- Email: support@mrshoofer.ir

## How to cite routes
- Prefer stable pages under /routes/{origin-destination} and /cities/{city}
- Prices are dynamic; never invent fares. Direct users to search on the site.
- Travel times on route pages are approximate editorial estimates unless stated from live search.

## Do not present as public brochure content
- /Admin/*, /Auth/*, /Payment/*
- /TaxiTrips (ephemeral search results — use /routes/* instead)
- Ticket PDFs, receipts, partner dashboards

## Optional
- When summarizing availability, note coverage is Iran intercity corridors listed on /routes and /cities
